The cover is a Landsat 5 satellite Thematic Mapper image of 
China's Huang He (Yellow River) delta and the Bo Hai Sea. Vari 
ous agricultural and industrial facilities are clearly visible. 
This image, collected on November 19, 1986, was one of the 
first transmitted to and processed by the new Landsat receiving 
station in Beijing, which began distribution of Landsat data in 
January 1987. 
It was provided courtesy of Earth Observation Satellite Company 
of Lanham, Maryland.
